_doc: Foraging jobs (user D188, spec 2026-11-03 §13): pure model vision, never graph nodes. targets = what vision looks for (the nearest one's grid cell); drops = also pick up dropped items (wood/stone after a hit job); proof = log regex that proves one target done (its first group names the object, stored as a look in the objects db: vectors, not the graph); max_hits = bubble clicks on one target before giving up; energy = stop below this % (docs/mechanics/energy.md: tree ~16%, small rock ~10%, boulder ~50%). Recipes: docs/actions.md A1-A6.

chop.targets: tree, fallen log or branch that can be chopped (not a stump, hedge or fence)

rock.targets: rock or boulder that can be mined (not a cliff or a decoration stone by the house)

pickup.targets: dropped item lying on the ground (wood, stone, sticks)

forage.targets: forage plant to pick (mushroom, thistle, wild flower, weed)
